title: Apartment 20 Carberry House Ard Ri, Athlone, Co. Westmeath
seoTitle: Apartment 20 Carberry House Ard Ri, Athlone, Co. Westmeath
description:
No. 20 Carberry House, Ard Ri, Dublin Road, Athlone - REA Hynes are delighted to present this bright and spacious two bedroom top floor apartment for lease. Ideally located within the popular Ard Ri gated complex, this property offers both comfort and convenience, making it an excellent choice. Measuring approximately 780 sq. ft., No. 20 is easily accessible via lift or stairs and is situated within Carberry House, a well maintained building of just 20 units. The accommodation comprises an entrance hall leading to a sitting room with a feature fireplace, front facing window, and south facing patio doors opening onto the sunny balcony. The galley kitchen is conveniently located off the sitting room, accessed through elegant double glass panel doors. It is fitted with stylish base and eye level units, complete with a built in cooker, hob, extractor fan, and is plumbed for a washing machine. The bright airy feel adds a touch of sophistication, while under cabinet lighting creates a bright and welcoming workspace. The kitchen also benefits from a side facing window, allowing plenty of natural light to fill the space. The property boasts two generously sized double bedrooms both with full height built in wardrobes, thoughtfully designed with shelving to maximise storage. The master bedroom is further enhanced by a built in vanity unit and a spacious ensuite shower room, providing a private and comfortable retreat. Soft carpeted flooring adds warmth and comfort throughout both bedrooms. The family bathroom is equally well appointed, featuring a bath with shower overhead, WC, and wash hand basin?combining style with everyday practicality. 
The Ard Ri development is a secure, gated community featuring five apartment buildings and 16 semi-detached homes, accessed via electric entrance gates. The grounds are beautifully maintained, with mature trees and hedging providing privacy, charm, and a sense of tranquility. Residents also enjoy a communal parking area with ample space for both visitors and multiple vehicles. Ideally located just off the Dublin Road, the development offers a highly convenient lifestyle, with Golden Island Shopping Centre only a short stroll away and Athlone town centre just minutes on foot. Combining a well kept, private setting with excellent accessibility, Ard Ri provides the perfect balance of comfort and convenience, making this apartment an exceptional choice. 
For further details please contact REA Hynes on email info@hynes.ie.

OutsideThe Ard Ri development benefits from beautifully maintained communal outdoor areas, including mature trees and hedging that provide privacy and a sense of tranquility. Residents can enjoy a south facing balcony with this particular apartment, while the development also offers a communal parking area with ample space for both residents and visitors. The combination of secure electric entrance gates and well kept landscaped grounds creates a safe, welcoming, and attractive environment.
